elements.name: Welcome to Tagma P0 S16 Acceptance Setup

Setup will guide you through the installation of Tagma P0 S16 Acceptance.

It is recommended that you close all other applications before starting Setup. This will make it possible to update relevant system files without having to reboot your computer.

Click Next to continue.

Installed version: 0.2.0-dev.33. This installer updates program files in place and keeps user data.

Quit Tagma and any separately started gateway before continuing. Active requests must finish first. To uninstall, use Windows Installed apps.
Choose the folder in which to install Tagma P0 S16 Acceptance.
Setup will install Tagma P0 S16 Acceptance in the following folder. To install in a different folder, click Browse and select another folder. Click Next to continue.
Please wait while Tagma P0 S16 Acceptance is being installed.
